key_observations: Orchestrator holds a list[PavithraSubagent] (line 63) created via create_subagent() factory (agent_template.py:605)
Execution is fully sequential (for agent in self.agents: determine() then execute()) — NOT truly parallel fan-out in the current implementation
Verification uses round-robin: verifier_id = agent_ids[(i + 1) % len(agent_ids)] (orchestrator.py:177)
Retry loop calls agent.execute() only (not re-determine) — preserves original determination
Fast 20ms mode skips all file I/O, isolation manager, and retry logic — pure in-memory pipeline with quick_verify()
Error recovery: exceptions in execute() are caught and recorded as FAILED status, pipeline continues to next agent
Output files are written with timestamp filenames: output_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json + OUTPUT_REPORT.md (overwritten each time)
